{
  "settings": [
    {
      "name": "s3_region",
      "input_type": "VARCHAR",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "To be able to read or write from S3, the correct region should be set:\n\n```sql\nSET s3_region = 'us-east-1';\n```",
      "default_kind": "absent",
      "default_value": null,
      "default_evidence": null
    },
    {
      "name": "s3_endpoint",
      "input_type": "VARCHAR",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "Optionally, the endpoint can be configured in case a non-AWS object storage server is used:\n\n```sql\nSET s3_endpoint = '⟨domain⟩.⟨tld⟩:⟨port⟩';\n```",
      "default_kind": "absent",
      "default_value": null,
      "default_evidence": null
    },
    {
      "name": "s3_use_ssl",
      "input_type": "BOOLEAN",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "If the endpoint is not SSL-enabled then run:\n\n```sql\nSET s3_use_ssl = false;\n```",
      "default_kind": "absent",
      "default_value": null,
      "default_evidence": null
    },
    {
      "name": "s3_url_style",
      "input_type": "VARCHAR",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "Switching between [path-style](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/VirtualHosting.html#path-style-access) and [vhost-style](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/VirtualHosting.html#virtual-hosted-style-access) URLs is possible using:\n\n```sql\nSET s3_url_style = 'path';\n```",
      "default_kind": "absent",
      "default_value": null,
      "default_evidence": null
    },
    {
      "name": "s3_access_key_id",
      "input_type": "VARCHAR",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "After configuring the correct endpoint and region, public files can be read. To also read private files, authentication credentials can be added:\n\n```sql\nSET s3_access_key_id = '⟨aws_access_key_id⟩';\nSET s3_secret_access_key = '⟨aws_secret_access_key⟩';\n```",
      "default_kind": "absent",
      "default_value": null,
      "default_evidence": null
    },
    {
      "name": "s3_secret_access_key",
      "input_type": "VARCHAR",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "After configuring the correct endpoint and region, public files can be read. To also read private files, authentication credentials can be added:\n\n```sql\nSET s3_access_key_id = '⟨aws_access_key_id⟩';\nSET s3_secret_access_key = '⟨aws_secret_access_key⟩';\n```",
      "default_kind": "absent",
      "default_value": null,
      "default_evidence": null
    },
    {
      "name": "s3_session_token",
      "input_type": "VARCHAR",
      "scope": "LOCAL",
      "evidence": "Alternatively, temporary S3 credentials are also supported. They require setting an additional session token:\n\n```sql\nSET s3_session_token = '⟨aws_session_token⟩';\n```",
      "default_kind": "absent",
      "default_value": null,
      "default_evidence": null
    }
  ]
}
